issue.title: Retire instruction_shadow_render
issue.description: every root provider invocation shadow-renders its instruction bundle and manifest into <artifacts>/instructions/, updates the agent_meta instructions summary, and exports SASE_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE during the call

task_type_fields.remove_when: E3 makes the rendered bundle the delivered instructions, or the E2 readout shows zero shadow failures and warm p95 within budget for 7 days
task_type_fields.when_disabled: invocations do exactly what they do today: no instructions files, no agent_meta summary, and no SASE_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE
task_type_fields.when_enabled: every root provider invocation shadow-renders its instruction bundle and manifest into <artifacts>/instructions/, updates the agent_meta instructions summary, and exports SASE_INSTRUCTIONS_FILE during the call

payload.description: Verify flag bead for instruction_shadow_render exists
